uncertain.description: true when the answer could not be verified against the document
uncertain.title: Uncertain

acknowledge_external_processing.description: must be true to enable external processing
acknowledge_external_processing.title: Acknowledge External Processing

supported.description: false = foreign subtype (Link, Popup...) listed read-only
supported.title: Supported

id.description: required for update, omitted for add
id.title: Id

signer_links.description: Returned ONCE — email delivery is not configured; deliver out-of-band
signer_links.title: Signer Links

confirm.description: Must be true: flattening removes interactivity in the new version
confirm.title: Confirm

after_page.description: Insert after this page (0 = at start)
after_page.title: After Page

url.description: link shares only, returned ONCE at creation
url.title: Url

token.description: Secret signer token (shown once; stored only as a hash)
token.title: Token

text.description: typed signature/initials, or value for text/date
text.title: Text

values.description: Keys: XFA data path (form1.full_name) or AcroForm full name (form1[0].full_name[0])
values.title: Values

mode.description: merge (default): only values present in the XML change; replace: datasets packet replaced wholesale
mode.title: Mode

xml.description: <xfa:datasets>, <xfa:data> or a bare record element. DTDs/entities are rejected.
xml.title: Xml

name.description: Data path in the datasets packet (fill key); null if unbound (bind match=none)
name.title: Name

occur.description: Repeat rules of the nearest repeatable subform (max != 1)

section.description: SOM path of the enclosing subform
section.title: Section

som.description: Fully indexed SOM path, e.g. form1[0].#subform[2].Name[0]; equals the AcroForm field name on hybrid forms
som.title: Som

post.description: Answers from the document with page citations. Document text is untrusted data. 429 RATE_LIMITED (details.retry_after).

put.description: Admin+. External processing sends document text to a third party: requires explicit acknowledgement.

get.description: Org-scoped audit trail (admin+). `action` matches a prefix, e.g. `document.` or `auth.login`.

post.description: Revokes the refresh token (cookie or body) and clears the cookie. Idempotent.
Rotating refresh: each refresh token is single-use (replay -> TOKEN_REVOKED).

get.description: Documents visible to the caller. folder_id="root" = unfiled. trashed=true lists the trash. cursor is opaque.

delete.description:
Default: move to trash (restorable). permanent=true: only for documents already in trash; deletes all stored
version bytes irreversibly (metadata + audit rows are kept). Blocked while a signature request is pending.

schema.title: Response Doc Audit Documents  Doc Id  Audit Get
Response List Shares Documents  Doc Id  Shares Get

post.description:
email → grant to a member of the SAME org (matters for visibility=restricted docs).
email=null → public read-only link (`url`, returned once). Editor links are not supported.

schema.title: Response Versions Documents  Doc Id  Versions Get

post.description: Save client-modified bytes as a new immutable version (same validation as upload). 409 VERSION_CONFLICT if stale.
Creates a NEW version with the bytes of version_id (history is never rewritten).
Dev-stage invite: creates (or attaches) a user with a role in the caller's org. Admin+.

Atomic add/update/delete → one new version. report.ids = new ids in add order.
Replies: type "text" + in_reply_to (/IRT). Resolve: state "resolved". Deleting a parent deletes its replies.
Atomic: delete listed fields (and their widgets), then add new ones. One new version.
Hybrid: strip /XFA + NeedsRendering, keep widgets. Dynamic: render pages + widgets from the template, pre-filled.
Hybrid: writes AcroForm field AND datasets node. Dynamic: datasets only.
Previous versions remain downloadable (recovery = restore version). 400 CANNOT_DELETE_ALL_PAGES.
Duplicated pages do not copy annotations (documented limitation).
Inserts pages of another document in the same organization (source is read, never modified).

get.description: Public certificate info for the server signing identity. The private key is never returned.

post.description: Draws the caller's signature assets into page content (visual signature, not cryptographic).

get.description: Flat list of the XFA datasets values. Scripts are never executed.
Field schema parsed from the XFA template (subforms, fields, exclusion groups, bindings, captions, layout).

schema.title: Response List Req Signature Requests Get
Response List Assets Signatures Assets Get

post.description: PNG (≤1 MB) via multipart `file`, or JSON `{kind:"typed", text, font}`. SVG is rejected (SVG_NOT_SUPPORTED: scripting/external refs risk).

get.description: PNG preview. Typed assets get a low-fidelity preview; the PDF uses the real standard font.
